 Screen Time: 2026’s Best Breakthrough Suncare Finalists
 Published November 17, 2026 
 BeautyMatter Studio 
 Published November 17, 2026 
 Skincare 
 Personal Care 
 Resources 
 Products 
 Dr. Jart+ 
 According to a survey by the American Academy of Dermatology (AAD), 73% of Americans use products to prevent premature aging, but only 56% use sunscreen daily. The BeautyMatter Awards Best Breakthrough Suncare finalists are doing their share to close that gap. Consumers are becoming more sophisticated with what they are looking for in sunscreen, and products that combine protection, convenience, cosmetic, and other skin health benefits are standing out. 
 With formulas that incorporate science-forward ingredients, lightweight textures, and invisible applications, the BeautyMatter Awards Best Breakthrough Suncare finalists are going beyond traditional UV protection. 
 Dr. Jart+ Every Sun Day Ultra-sheer Priming Sunscreen Stick : A Korean-style, swipe-on sunscreen stick that blends UV protection, hydrating ingredients like hyaluronic acid and transparent Oleoactif, and makeup prep into a portable format—all of which encourage consumers to use sunscreen more frequently. (0.67 oz / $32)
 Epicutis Lipid Shield SPF 30 : A tinted, mineral-based sunscreen formulated with non-nano zinc oxide and TSC (tetramethylhexadecenyl succinoyl cysteine), a biotech-developed lipid that is said to soothe redness, protect collagen, and support skin repair. The formula also includes antioxidants such as bisabolol, a natural compound that relieves irritation; dipotassium glycyrrhizinate, which evens the skin tone; and aloe vera, which aids in recovery after sun exposure. (1.7 oz / $90)
 Kiehl’s Better Screen Miner-ALL UV Serum : A mineral SPF reimagined as a sheer, lightweight serum. The UV serum offers SPF 50 broad-spectrum protection with filters titanium dioxide and zinc oxide. Prioritizing wearability and skin comfort, the sun serum also has bisabolol, said to help ease redness and irritation, and Cica to support the skin barrier and recovery. (1.4 fl oz / $36)
 Supergoop! Unseen Sunscreen SPF 50 : An oil-free, lightweight SPF that dries down completely clear. By removing common obstacles such as white cast and heaviness, the Unseen Sunscreen is designed to integrate seamlessly into all skincare routines, making daily sunscreen use feel more accessible. Its velvety gel finish means the sunscreen doubles as a makeup base, encouraging daily use. The Unseen Sunscreen has also earned The Skin Cancer Foundation's Seal of Recommendation, further underscoring its reliability.  (1.7 fl oz / $38)
 Timebeam Beauty Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 : A mineral sunscreen that goes beyond protecting the skin from UV rays, this sunscreen combines 10% zinc oxide with astaxanthin, an antioxidant that combats skin damage caused by UV exposure and environmental stressors. The Sunbeam Daily Mineral Sunscreen also contains niacinamide, vitamin C, and hyaluronic acid to help even skin tone and hydrate the skin, making daily sunscreen use a ritual that supports skin longevity while improving the appearance of the skin in real time. (1.7 fl oz / $38)
